title: Your Losing Fund Still Sent the IRS a $1,842 Bill
hook: Your mutual fund lost 18% last year — then you got an IRS tax bill for $1,842 anyway. It's called phantom income, and 80% of fund investors have no idea it's happening.
angle: Mutual fund capital gains distributions blindside investors with tax bills even in down years — a structural flaw ETFs don't share
audience: Anyone with mutual funds in a taxable brokerage account
key_numbers: $1.3 trillion distributed in 2022 during an 18% market crash
80% of active mutual funds distribute capital gains annually
ETFs distribute near-zero capital gains due to in-kind redemptions
